title: Follow one ticket
goal: Follow one ticket from the moment you assign it to Nova until a person may merge its PR, and write the rule that decides whose approval counts.

guess.q: You (Sean) asked Nova for a change. Nova opened the PR, Byte (the review agent) approved it, and then you approved it too. May a person press Merge now?

options.text: Yes, because the PR has two approvals.
options.why: Neither approval counts: Byte is an agent, and you are the person who asked for the change.

options.text: No. It still needs one approval from a person who did not ask for the change, like Dana.
options.why: Approvals from agents and bots never count, and the requester can't approve their own agent's work, so the PR waits for one other person.

options.text: Yes, but only you may press Merge, because it is your ticket.
options.why: Asking for the change gives you no extra power: your approval does not count, so nobody may merge yet.

build: Open approval.mjs and write canMerge(pr, approvals) so it gives back { ok, reason }. Approvals from agents and bots never count, the requester's own approval never counts, and one approval from any other person is needed (one is enough). Run node journey.mjs: the answer is now no, because Byte is an agent and you (Sean) asked for the change. Then add Dana's approval as the last event in events.json, { "at": "10:20", "who": "dana", "type": "approve", "text": "approved PR #2512" }, and run it again: now the answer is yes. Finish with ./academy check.
fix: Last week someone made canMerge "simpler", and this morning a PR was merged after only Byte had approved it, so no person had looked at it. Run node journey.mjs --fix to see the wrong yes, then repair fix/approval.mjs so an agent's approval no longer counts.
explain: Why can't the person who asked for the change approve their own agent's PR?
Byte reviews every PR. Why doesn't Byte's approval count, even when Byte is right?
Why does the Jira poll write down who asked, at the very start, instead of looking it up when the PR is ready?
done: ./academy check passes and prints your pass code, and node journey.mjs says yes only after Dana approves.
